meta.title: GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Open or perform GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match and observe its automatic GRN-to-PO line matching result.
Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and as a Warehouse Executive to compare refusal or absence versus availability.
Verify or record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
